title: Sections of a constant etale sheaf are locally constant maps
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an abelian group, and let $\underline E$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto E$ on the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], i.e. the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. A map $f:|T|\to E$ is *Zariski-locally constant* if every point $x\in|T|$ has a Zariski-open neighbourhood $V$ on which $f$ is constant; equivalently, every fibre $f^{-1}(\{e\})$ is Zariski open (the converse follows because an arbitrary fibre is the union of the open neighbourhoods on which $f$ has value $e$). Let $\operatorname{LC}_{\mathrm{Zar}}(|T|,E)$ be the abelian group of such maps, with pointwise addition. Then, by the Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology, Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5), using the representability input Lemma 59.15.8 (Tag 03O3), there is a canonical isomorphism of abelian groups $\underline E(T)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{LC}_{\mathrm{Zar}}(|T|,E)$ taking the section $\iota_T(e)$ induced by $e\in E$ to the constant map with value $e$.

source.place: Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology, Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5, label etale-cohomology-remark-constant-locally-constant-maps): the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value a group G has Gamma(U, G) equal to the Zariski-locally-constant maps U -> G. The remark identifies the Zariski sheafification with the representable constant group scheme of Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW), and uses Etale Cohomology, Lemma 59.15.8 (Tag 03O3), that representable presheaves satisfy the fpqc sheaf condition.

proof.text: Let $T_E=\coprod_{e\in E}T$ be the constant group scheme over $T$ (Groupoids, Example 39.5.6, Tag 03YW). By [lem-weil-pbc-constant-group-scheme-morphism-clopen], for every etale $T$-scheme $U$ the representable presheaf $h_{T_E}(U)=\operatorname{Mor}_T(U,T_E)$ is the set of clopen decompositions $U=\coprod_{e\in E}U_e$, equivalently maps $|U|\to E$ with open fibres. Under this identification the canonical map $E\to h_{T_E}(U)$ sends $e$ to the morphism whose $e$-piece is all of $U$ and whose other pieces are empty, exactly the constant map with value $e$; the group law is pointwise addition.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5), using Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW)

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf], $h_{T_E}$ is a sheaf on the small etale site (Stacks Lemma 59.15.8, Tag 03O3). Let $P_E$ be the constant presheaf $U\mapsto E$, let $\eta:P_E\to P_E^\#=\underline E$ be its sheafification map, and let $\alpha:P_E\to h_{T_E}$ be the map of Step 1. Since $h_{T_E}$ is a sheaf, $\alpha$ factors uniquely as $P_E\xrightarrow{\eta}\underline E\xrightarrow{\varphi}h_{T_E}$. Conversely, every section of $h_{T_E}(U)$ has the clopen decomposition of Step 1, so the family of its nonempty pieces is an etale covering of $U$ on each member of which it is $\alpha(e)$, a constant section. Thus $h_{T_E}$ is the sheaf associated to $P_E$ and the sheafification comparison $\varphi:\underline E\xrightarrow{\sim}h_{T_E}$ is an isomorphism by the sheafification universal property (equivalently, local representatives give surjectivity and the sheaf uniqueness condition gives injectivity). Taking $U=T$ identifies $\underline E(T)$ with the group of Zariski-locally-constant maps $|T|\to E$, and the factorization carries $\iota_T(e)$ to the constant map with value $e$.

lean.statement: theorem constantSheaf_sections_locallyConstant (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Type u) [AddCommGroup E] : ∃ φ : AddEquiv (↑(((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (AddCommGrpCat.{u})).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of E)).obj.obj (Opposite.op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))))) (LocallyConstant T E), ∀ e : E, φ (((toSheafify T.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const T.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of E))).app (Opposite.op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T)))) e) = LocallyConstant.const T e
